Thanks, James. You're verified, so I can help with Sarah's plan. What would you like to know?
Is Bayview Physical Therapy covered, and what would she pay there?

Bayview is out of network, so Sarah would pay 40 percent of the cost after her deductible. At an in-network clinic, she'd pay a 30 dollar copay per visit. Harbor Physical Therapy is 2 miles away and in network. These are estimates based on her 2026 Gold PPO plan.
